why: Builds the full taxa x taxa phylogenetic distance as a file-backed bigmemory matrix, so disk is 8 x taxa^2 bytes (code); time grows with taxa^2 because every pair is summed over its two root paths (derived). It slows sharply when the file is larger than free memory or sits on a network file system. Measured on the 16S probe (2026-08-11, 48-sample tree, two points, 14,832 and 44,497 tips): time O(n^2.23), memory O(n^2.00); at 44,497 tips the build took 47.7 min with a 15.85 GB matrix and a 48.9 GB process peak (measured; that probe used decimal GB). Scope is the distance build of the 8 matrix-bound metrics (mpd, mntd and their ses and abundance-weighted forms); Faith's PD (faith_pd, ses_faith_pd) needs the tree only, O(n) memory (code).
knob: put cachePath on local disk (the distance work dir lives under it)
